V-RRrR-CEA is not valid|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 36 ([[Translated#Dialogue|Translated Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Necromancer King''', internally referred to as the '''Summoner2''' and formerly known as '''Necromancer Boss''', which is also the name for its legacy version, is a summoner enemy that appears in [[Polluted Wasteland II]] and [[Challenge Trials]]. It has a very high amount of health, higher than all enemies that appeared before it, and an above average speed, faster than the [[Warden (Modern Enemy)|Warden]]. It also has one ability, where it will spin its staff, summoning five [[Giant Skeleton]]s. Unlike the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]], its underling counterpart, it does not pause to summon enemies, making it more threatening. It also has [[Freeze Immunity]], making it immune to being chilled or frozen, and it has [[Stun Immunity]], which makes it only slow down by 40% instead of stunned by stunning towers like the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]] and immune to knockback. ==Appearance== The '''Necromancer King''' has a desaturated dark green skin color and a black torso, legs, sleeves and cape. Some of its head is missing skin, revealing its skull. It has grey metal shoulder-pads that resemble skulls with a purple interior and a grey metal neck-guard, with purple gems decorating it. It also wears a crimson leather belt with a purple crystal and a metal crown with multiple diamond shaped crystals on them. It wields a brown wooden staff with a metal base, which has a gem, and a skull on top, which has light red streaks on it. It uses this staff to summon [[Giant Skeleton]]s. It also emits purple particles. ==Strategy== *Deal with this enemy as soon as possible. Leaving the '''Necromancer King''' alive for too long will allow it to summon a vast amount of [[Giant Skeleton]]s. *The [[Ranger]], [[Accelerator]], [[Minigunner]] and [[Turret]] are great at dealing with the '''Necromancer King''' and the [[Giant Skeleton]]s it summons. **You may want to set these towers to ''Strongest'' to ignore the enemies that the '''Necromancer King''' spawns. The [[Saboteur]] can also be used for this purpose. **You can boost the firerate of these towers with the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability whenever the '''Necromancer King''' spawns. *Splash damage towers, such as the [[Rocketeer]] or [[Mortar]], can be great at dealing with the [[Giant Skeleton]]s the '''Necromancer King''' summons. **They can also be useful at dealing damage to the '''Necromancer King'''. Do note, however, that these towers do not have enough DPS to deal with the '''Necromancer King''' on their own. *Do note that you do not earn any money from the summoned enemies. *Because of the '''Necromancer King's''' immunities, freezing towers like the [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Sledger]] cannot freeze or slow it down. **Stunning towers such as the [[Electroshocker]] can only slow it down, while knockback towers such as the [[Brawler]] cannot knock it back. Additionally, the [[Warden]] will slow it down for a shorter amount of time because of its size. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSummoner2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} V.1.6.1_Icon.png|'''Necromancer King''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- ☢️ NUCLEAR Update!☢️|'''Necromancer King''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} NecromancerBossGIClean.png|'''Necromancer King''' on a render. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} NecromancerBossIndex.png|'''Necromancer King''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *Despite now being called the '''Necromancer King''', [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] still refers to it as the "''Necromancer Boss''" in [[Challenge Trials]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''29 July 2022''' -
